name: maaza-cafe-management-system
description: Full-Stack Maaza Cafe Management System (Frontend + Backend)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
